thread:
devon: Quick sync — RFC review this week. We have four authors but only three slots on Thu 11am. Can folks confirm availability?

maria: I can take a slot, prefer earlier in the agenda.

aj: Available Thu 11, but I'm oncall Wed afternoon so can't pre-read until Wed evening.

sara: I have conflicts Thu 11–11:30, can do 11:30+ or Fri.

tom: I'm out Thu morning; can do 11:45 or swap with someone.

devon: OK — looks like we should stagger authors. Plan: 11:00 author A, 11:20 author B, 11:40 author C, then open Q&A. That gives ~15–18min each. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: That sounds good. Also can we reorder to put the most controversial RFC second? saves time if it needs extra review.

aj: Agreed. Which RFC is controversial? (tagging authors) @maria @tom

maria: The caching/slotting RFC — I expect deep perf questions. I'm happy to move mine to slot 2.

opsbot: Reminder: please upload pre-reads to the RFC folder 24h before the meeting. See: https://drive.company/rfcs/review-guidelines :bell:

devon: Can authors confirm pre-read status:
- maria: uploaded?
- tom: will upload by Wed 6pm?
- aj: will upload Wed 9pm (oncall earlier)

maria: uploaded just now, filename: rfc-caching-slotting-v3.md :white_check_mark:

tom: will upload by 6pm Wed, sorry for the late notice.

aj: will post Wed 9pm, ping me if deadline slips.

sara: I'll handle reviewer assignment — volunteer pool: me, devon, aj, liu. Prefer at least two primary reviewers per RFC.

devon: Assignments so far:
- RFC A (maria): reviewers sara + aj
- RFC B (tom): reviewers devon + liu
- RFC C (aj): reviewers sara + maria

aj: LGTM. For the meeting agenda, can we add 5min at the start for quick triage of outstanding action items? keeps us on time.

devon: Yes — new agenda: 5m triage, 3 x 18m author slots (incl 5m for live Q/A), 10m wrap. I'll update the calendar invite and put the agenda + links in the event.

maria: Small ask — can we note in the invite which RFCs need priority decisions (merge / iterate)? helps reviewers prep.

devon: Good call. I'll annotate each slot with: objective = decision / feedback / informational.

opsbot: Calendar updated by devon: Thu 11am — RFC review. Agenda + links added.

tom: Thanks. If someone needs me earlier, I can swap with aj for slot 3.

sara: I'll confirm reviewer availability tomorrow and post a short checklist for reviewers:
```
- read pre-read
- leave 3 focused comments (API, perf, rollout)
- mark decision: approve / needs changes / defer
```

devon: Perfect. Last request: authors, drop 3 quick bullets under each RFC describing what you need from reviewers (e.g., API stability, perf numbers, rollout constraints). Helps focus the 18m.

maria: Done — added bullets to my pre-read.

aj: Will add mine Wed night.

tom: Will include bullets with upload.

devon: Thanks all — I'll send a final reminder tomorrow 11am with the ordered agenda and reviewer callouts. :thumbsup:
